framework.alignmentRules: not_enough_evidence: nothing to read yet, or no competency in the framework has any evidence (even a claim). requirements_demonstrated: every required competency is met (expected level, demonstrated evidence). strong: every required competency has an assessed level, at least half are met, and every required competency with no required prerequisite (the foundations) is met. developing: at least one required competency is met, or at least half have an assessed level. early: anything else with some evidence. Supporting competencies never raise the state.
